The '''reporter''' was a journalist who worked for the [[Galaxy News Network]] in [[Timeline (2050-2099)#2077|2077]]. 

==Background==
This journalist was assigned to commentate on the public unveiling of [[Vault 33]] which occurred a week after the [[Battle of Anchorage|U.S. victory at Anchorage]] on January 10, 2077. As a journalist, he was not used to the type of improvisation needed by live television anchors and was more used to reporting news stories as they were given. Though the broadcast initially went well, the journalist found it increasingly difficult to perform his job because of technical difficulties and his incompetent intern assistant [[Arnold (Galaxy News Network)|Arnold]], and he spiralled into hysteria and gloom over the of the modern world.<ref name="0:">''[[Fallout - A Special LIVE Report from Galaxy News]]''</ref>

As the coverage continued, the reporter, much to his dismay, would learn that he would share a [[Vault]] together with Arnold. However, over time, the reporter accepted this and hoped the tour would soon begin.<ref name="0:" />

==Appearances==
The reporter appears only in the ''[[Fallout - A Special LIVE Report from Galaxy News]]''.

'''Rink''' is a wastelander {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
[[Javin]] and Rink are a pair of wastelanders in the [[Los Angeles]] area around [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]]. They are apparently [[cannibalism|cannibals]] who try to fool their victims by pretending to be unarmed and then attacking when they get near. They use rotten teeth as ammunition.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Past]]===
Javin and Rink meet [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[Maximus]] at the opposite end of a railway bridge while the latter two are near the ruins of [[Shady Sands]], tracking [[Thaddeus]]. They initially pretend to be cautious travelers, calling out to Lucy and Maximus and asking whether or not they are armed. Lucy does not think anything more of it, but Maximus is correctly suspicious, seeing that Javin and Rink are hiding their own weapons. Maximus offers to stay there and let them pass the bridge first, but Javin claims that this is a trap. With the standoff leading nowhere, Lucy suggests they all calm down and pass on opposite sides of the bridge with their hands raised to show they are non-hostile. Maximus, Javin, and Rink all agree, grudgingly.
